record.description: The refusal names the file, line, record, and field, on the read path and on the read that a write uses, and leaves the shard byte-identical. A schema_version key is an unknown field. Replaces rule_reads_supported_version_only and rule_schema_version_one under the owner ruling of 2026-10-05 (provenance-u9mg).
record.statement: A stored record line that has a field that its record kind does not define is refused before conversion or rewrite.
